I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks Ilse, noted: Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261 seats."

She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so no approval was required. There are no Quarrendon files in the share yet (accounts/quarrendon is empty), so for now the only record of the 261 seats is her message and my reply.
